comparisons.author_judgement: 团簇多硫化物促进 Li2S4→Li2S
comparisons.quote: The initial specific capacity of Li─S cells with 60DTL electrolyte was increased from 1002 to 1371 mAh g−1 at 0.1 C, and the overpotential was reduced from 173 to 116 mV

comparisons.reason_quote: due to the effective inhibition of the shuttle effect
comparisons.quote: the coulombic efficiency of cells with 60DTL electrolyte is increased from 76.3% to 99.6% due to the effective inhibition of the shuttle effect
The initial specific capacity of Li─S cells with 60DTL electrolyte was increased from 1002 to 1371 mAh g−1 at 0.1 C, and the overpotential was reduced from 173 to 116 mV

The specific capacities of cells with 60DTL were 1371, 1164, 1078, 998, 914, 841, and 702 mAh g−1 at 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, and 5 C, respectively. In comparison, cells with 0DTL can only realize capacities of 1116, 787, 707, 624, 569, 510, and 302 mAh g−1

comparisons.reason_quote: Cells using 0DTL electrolytes exhibit rapid capacity decay due to the severe shuttle effect
comparisons.quote: The capacity retention of cells with 60DTL and 0DTL after 200 cycles at 1 C was 90.6% and 12.2%, respectively

Cells with 60DTL electrolyte still have a specific capacity of 1165 mAh g−1 after 100 h resting, with a capacity loss of only 4.5%. The specific capacity of cells with 0DTL electrolyte was dropped from 955 to 460 mAh g−1, with a capacity loss of 51.8%
The shuttle current of Li─S cells with 60DTL was reduced from 2.1 to 0.6 μA

comparisons.note: A 的 640 来自 Fig. 5d（与 0DTL 对比），B 的 230 来自 Fig. S20a，假定两图条件相同
comparisons.quote: In electrolyte without LiNO3, DOL/DME electrolyte only has a Coulombic efficiency of 76% and a specific capacity of 230 mAh g−1 after 400 cycles … In contrast, cells with 60DTL electrolytes show significantly improved cycling stability, with a capacity of 640 mAh g−1 after 400 cycles

comparisons.author_judgement: CPE 极化斜率更小，动力学更快
comparisons.quote: The rate performance of DOL/DME electrolyte (DOL/DME = 1/1, v/v) was also compared with our electrolyte. Nevertheless, cells with 60DTL electrolytes still have higher specific capacities
The cell with 60DTL electrolyte still has a capacity of 639 mAh g−1 after 600 cycles at 1 C, and the capacity degradation is reduced from 50.65% to 29.86%

comparisons.reason_quote: As shown in Figure 3f, the deposition process in 0DTL electrolyte could not proceed due to the large overpotential
comparisons.quote: As shown in Figure 3f, the deposition process in 0DTL electrolyte could not proceed due to the large overpotential … The highest deposition capacity of Li2S (434 mAh g−1) was observed in 60DTL electrolytes

comparisons.note: 对比所用载量正文未写明
comparisons.quote: The 0DTL electrolyte with the E/S (ratio of the volume of electrolyte to the mass of sulfur) of 5.0 μL mg−1 only released a capacity of 699 mAh g−1, and cells failed to operate after 75 cycles … In comparison, the cells with 60 DTL still had a specific capacity of 714 mAh g−1 after 100 cycles

comparisons.author_judgement: 0DTL 多硫化物浓度高、粘度大、电导下降
comparisons.reason_quote: the high concentration of polysulfides in 0DTL electrolyte caused the severe shuttling effect along with a sharp increase in viscosity causing a decrease in ionic conductivity
comparisons.quote: After further reducing the electrolyte amount to <4.0 μL mg−1, the high concentration of polysulfides in 0DTL electrolyte caused the severe shuttling effect along with a sharp increase in viscosity causing a decrease in ionic conductivity, and ultimately the cells failed after eight cycles. In contrast, the 60DTL electrolyte can achieve an area capacity of 4 mAh cm−2 and cycle steadily for 50 cycles
The 0DTL electrolyte fails to operate after 500 h, while the 60DTL electrolyte can be operated stably for up to 800 h at the current of 1 mA cm−2 and 1mAh cm−2
